TechnicianMark StowAttended18 Sep 2026 · 1.5 hrs

Issue reported

Far-end participants couldn’t hear anyone in the room during Teams and Webex calls. Local playback worked, but the ceiling microphones weren’t being picked up by the codec.

Work carried out

The Ceiling Mic Pro had dropped off the network after a recent switch firmware update turned off PoE on its port. We re-enabled PoE, replaced a damaged patch lead at the wall plate, re-paired the mic to the codec and ran a test call with your IT team. Audio is now clear in both directions.

Parts and gear used

QtyItemNote
1CAT6A patch lead, 2 mReplaced damaged lead at wall plate
1RJ45 keystone insertWall plate re-terminated

Advice for the client

  • Let us know before any network switch firmware updates, so AV ports keep PoE turned on.
  • Run a quick test call after network changes, so issues are caught before a meeting.
  • Keep a spare patch lead in the credenza for a fast swap if it happens again.
